    • locateAllWithScopePath

      default LocatorAllResult locateAllWithScopePath(LocatorContext context, LocatorDefinition definition)
      Resolves all compatible candidates together with the scope path actually used to find them. See LocatorAllResult. The default implementation falls back to context's starting baseline scope path, for implementations that do not separately track the live-resolved scope; LocatorEngine overrides this with the real resolved scope from the same resolution attempt, never a second independent live resolution.

    • locateAllWithScopePath

      default LocatorAllResult locateAllWithScopePath(ILiveLocatorContext context, LocatorDefinition definition)
